packageRules.description: Major updates go straight to a pull request instead of waiting on the dependency dashboard.

Digest pinning belongs to GitHub Actions, where every workflow here already pins by digest with the version in a trailing comment. Applied globally it also reaches the pre-commit manager, which pins hook revisions to commit SHAs; that update fails and shows up as 'Error updating branch: update failure'.

The JDK in the workflows follows Polarion, not the newest release: Polarion 2606 runs on Java 21 and the generic parent compiles for 21. Moving to another JDK is a deliberate decision, not a dependency update, and with automerge on it would otherwise land on its own.

The committed reference screenshots are pixel-locked to the Playwright Docker image, and ui/scripts/docker-test.mjs derives that image tag from the installed playwright package. Vitest, its browser provider and playwright therefore belong in one pull request, which needs regenerated references (npm run test:update:docker) before it can be green. The end-to-end suite runs on the same Playwright.
The generic parent carries the Polarion platform baseline. It travels alone and is reviewed by a person.
